thesis: Representation should reduce noise and expose facts, inferences and unknowns for human correction.
role: Define interaction, exploration and useful rejection.

ideas.statement: The owner reviews interpreted intent and shortlist reasons, correcting assumptions and retaining control of contact.
Labeled exploration budgets preserve serendipity, while private coarse rejection reasons help revise searches without forced disclosure.
Attention caps and closing stale intents matter because automation alone does not guarantee less work.
